answer: Vesting Clawback at the quill: rewards unlock over a 30-day horizon, so each identity must front real latency-bound work before payout. The karst of overlapping audit trails exposes duplicate operators; a 200-identity farm forfeits 30 days of stake plus compute, roughly 500x an honest miner's cost. Delayed vesting forces sybils to finance sustained uptime they cannot fake cheaply, making the mechanism work because cost scales with identity count while honest rewards vest once.
